scope: Proposition 2.4 of the manuscript “A power saving for planar unit distances” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-planar-unit-distances-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 167 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 72bfa9153772b212), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: From a sequence of n = t3 real planar points with at least t4−o(1) ordered unit pairs, one can obtain real algebraic point and center sets P, Q, and a nonempty graph E ⊆ P × Q consisting of unit incidences, with the following properties. There is a parameter a = a(t) > 0 such that a → 0, a log t → ∞, and |P| = t1+2a+o(a) , |Q| = t2+a+o(a) , |E| = t2+2a+o(a) . (2.2) Writing d(p), d(q) for graph degrees, uniformly over all vertices, d(p) = t1+o(a) , d(q) = ta+o(a) . (2.3) The uniform law on E has marginals µ(p) = d(p)/|E| and κ(q) = d(q)/|E| satisfying µ(p) ≥ γ |P| , κ(q) ≥ γ |Q| , γ = 27 50 = 0.54. (2.4) Set η = γ − 1 2 = 1/25. There is a single sequence ξt → 0 such that, for every F ⊆ P and G ⊆ Q, with counting fractions u = |F|/|P| and v = |G|/|Q|, PE(p ∈ F, q ∈ G) ≤ √ uv (uv)η + ξt  . (2.5) The sequence ξt is independent of the chosen subsets.
